messages:
maya_cs: Quick heads-up — Twin Studio PM pinged me this morning: they're activating 3 new squads (Search / Summarize / Recs) and want embeddings + realtime summarization. Expect baseline QPS ~200 now, planning to ramp to ~2k over 4–6 weeks. Asking about Dedicated pool + VPC separation and an onboarding playbook.

liam_eng: Thanks. Do we have any committed $ or PO on the table yet? Also need target latency/cost constraints.

maya_cs: No PO yet, PM asked for a cost/latency estimate to share with execs. They specifically called out p95 latency and token-cost per summary. Also SSO + workspace isolation questions.

olivia_onboard: I can lead onboarding for this one. Plan: 2-week canary with 1 squad, then expand. Need: model choices, expected sequence length, ingest cadence, and their SRE contact.

alex_prod: Product recs (first pass): use curated embed model (curie-embed-quant) for vector ops and chat-llama-v2-7b-q4 for summarization streaming. For seq lengths ~4k, aim for p95 generation < 250ms with streaming enabled.

liam_eng: From infra POV we should pre-warm Dedicated: recommend 4x A40-equivalent pods to hit that QPS headroom, prefix caching + KV offload. Set autoscale burst to 3x for peaks. If agreed I can open a reservation request.

maya_cs: PM asked for an onboarding kickoff — proposing Tue 10am PT. I'll slot that and invite engineering + their SRE. Also flagged this as a potential expansion that could accelerate renewal.

olivia_onboard: I'll draft a playbook and enablement slide deck for their SREs. Need their SSO metadata and VPC CIDR to validate network policies.

alex_prod: Can eng/research produce a short quantization/config guidance for seq=4096? They want recommended batch sizes and cache TTLs. Point-of-contact?

liam_eng: I'll partner with applied-ml and runtime. Draft config snippet below to start — we can optimize after telemetry:

``` 
model: chat-llama-v2-7b-q4
batching:
  min_batch: 8
  max_latency_ms: 50
kv_cache:
  ttl_ms: 300000
```

liam_eng: Also recommend enabling prefix cache and a per-route token limit. I'll create internal ticket and attach perf estimates.

deploy-bot: reservation request submitted — id rs-20240301-1732109876. Pools requested: 4 nodes, burst 3x. Provisioning ETA ~48h.

maya_cs: Great — I'll update the CRM and calendar. Quick ask: what are the customer-side risks if we can't get Dedicated provisioned before their full ramp?

alex_prod: Risk is moderate: they'd see higher tail latency and token-cost. Could lead them to evaluate competitor endpoints for latency-sensitive paths. Suggest offering a short-term trial credit + contractual expansion option to lock them in.

maya_cs: Noted — I'll propose trial credit in the kickoff. Tagging owners: @olivia_onboard to own playbook, @liam_eng to own capacity reservation and ENG ticket. I'll add follow-up notes after kickoff. :thumbsup:

liam_eng: Ack — creating ENG-4852 to track capacity + perf tuning. Will loop in eng-runtime and infra.

olivia_onboard: I'll post the playbook draft to the account folder before the kickoff and include a checklist for SSO/VPC items.

maya_cs: Thanks team — moving to prep.
